name: 家电深度清洁周期提醒

map.家电深度清洁周期提醒是做什么的？: What does Appliance Deep-Cleaning Cycle Reminder do?
map.如何使用家电深度清洁周期提醒？: How do I use Appliance Deep-Cleaning Cycle Reminder?
map.家电深度清洁周期提醒适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Appliance Deep-Cleaning Cycle Reminder best for?
map.内置 8 类家电推荐清洁周期，添加家电并记录上次清洁日期，自动计算下次清洁时间，: Built-in recommended cleaning cycles for 8 appliance types: add an appliance and record its last cleaning date to automatically calculate the next cleaning time, produce a cleaning queue sorted by urgency, and get professional cleaning tips.
map.📖 查看「家电深度清洁周期提醒使用指南」: 📖 View the "Appliance Deep-Cleaning Cycle Reminder Guide"
map.暂无家电，请先添加: No appliances yet; please add one first
map.清洁周期为通用推荐值，使用频率高的家电可适当缩短周期: Cleaning cycles are general recommendations; frequently used appliances may need a shorter cycle
map.深度清洁涉及拆解的家电（空调内机、油烟机叶轮等）建议请专业人员操作: Deep cleaning that involves dismantling appliances (air-conditioner indoor unit, range-hood impeller and so on) should be left to a professional
map.清洁前务必断电断气，确保安全后再操作: Always cut power and gas before cleaning, and only start once it is safe
map.标记清洁后会自动重置下次清洁倒计时: Marking a cleaning automatically resets the next-cleaning countdown
map.登记空调、洗衣机、油烟机等家电的类型与上次清洁日期，自动算出下次该清洁的时间。: Record the type and last cleaning date of appliances such as air conditioners, washing machines and range hoods to automatically calculate when the next cleaning is due.
map.大扫除前把即将到期的家电一次性列出来，集中安排清洁。: Before a big clean, list all the appliances coming due at once and schedule the cleaning together.
map.养成定期清洁习惯后回填每次实际日期，让提醒周期随实际执行滚动更新。: Once a regular habit is formed, fill in each actual date so the reminder cycle rolls forward with real execution.
map.若空调的清洁周期为 90 天、上次清洁为 6 月 1 日，则下次清洁日期为 8: If the air conditioner's cycle is 90 days and it was last cleaned on 1 June, the next cleaning date is 30 August; the closer today is to that date, the fewer days remain, making it easy to plan ahead.
map.按类型套用不同周期: Apply a different cycle by type
map.不同家电的推荐深度清洁周期不同（如滤网类较短、内部管路类较长），页面按所选类型套: Different appliances have different recommended deep-cleaning cycles (filter types are shorter, internal-duct types longer); the page applies the cycle for the selected type so not every appliance uses the same frequency.
map.家电清单与清洁记录保存在浏览器本地存储，不会上传；清理浏览器数据后需重新录入。: The appliance list and cleaning records are saved in browser local storage and are not uploaded; clearing browser data means you must re-enter them.
map.能提醒多个家电吗？: Can it remind me about several appliances?
map.可以。逐项登记后，页面按各自上次清洁日期与周期分别推算下次清洁日期并列出。: Yes. Once each is registered, the page calculates the next cleaning date for each from its own last date and cycle and lists them.
map.周期可以自己改吗？: Can I change the cycle myself?
map.周期由所选家电类型决定；若使用环境特殊（如粉尘大），可在记录备注中注明并适当提前: The cycle is determined by the selected appliance type; if the environment is unusual (e.g. very dusty), note it and bring the actual cleaning forward accordingly.
map.家庭家电清洁管理工具。内置空调滤网、空调深度、洗衣机、冰箱、热水器、油烟机、微波: A home appliance cleaning management tool. It has built-in recommended cleaning cycles for 8 appliance types - air-conditioner filter, deep air-conditioner, washing machine, refrigerator, water heater, range hood, microwave and water dispenser - automatically calculates the next cleaning time after an appliance is added, produces a cleaning queue sorted by urgency, and gives professional cleaning tips for each type, helping families schedule deep cleaning sensibly.
map.8 类家电周期数据库: A cycle database for 8 appliance types
